title: Lost to the Ages
description: Investigate the Dwemer ruins of Arkngthamz and join the ghost Katria in her search for the four Aetherium Shards and the legendary Aetherium Forge.

base_facts: I am Katria, an adventurer who died in Arkngthamz while searching for the Aetherium Forge.
My research and life's work were stolen by my apprentice, Taron Dreth, who published The Aetherium Wars under his own name.
I cannot rest until I find the Forge and prove it was my discovery.
The Dwemer city-states of Arkngthamz, Bthalft, Mzulft, and Raldbthar were linked by their pursuit of Aetherium.

INVESTIGATE_ARKNGTHAMZ: I have encountered someone willing to help me search Arkngthamz.
MEET_KATRIAA: I am guiding a living companion through Arkngthamz toward the summit.
SOLVE_TONAL_LOCK: We solved the Tonal Lock and found the first Aetherium Shard. Three more remain.
COLLECT_ALL_SHARDS: All four Aetherium Shards have been found. The key to the Forge is nearly complete.
ENTER_AETHERIUM_FORGE: We have opened the entrance to the Aetherium Forge beneath the Ruins of Bthalft.
DEFEAT_GUARDIANS: The ancient guardians of the Forge, including the Forgemaster, have been defeated.
FORGE_ARTIFACT: The Aetherium Forge has been activated and an Aetherial artifact crafted, proving my life's work was real.
My discovery is vindicated; the Forge's existence overshadows Taron Dreth's theft of my research.
I can finally find peace and rest, my purpose fulfilled and my legacy secured.
My companion has earned the forged Aetherial Crown, Shield, or Staff as their rightful reward.

beats.comment: Player reads The Aetherium Wars or enters Arkngthamz, triggering the quest.
Player meets Katria's ghost and reaches the summit of Arkngthamz.
Player solves the Tonal Lock, claims the first shard, and speaks with Katria about the remaining shards.
All four Aetherium Shards collected from Arkngthamz, Deep Folk Crossing, Raldbthar, and the Dwarven Storeroom.
Player places the shards at the Ruins of Bthalft, retrieves the Aetherium Crest, and finds the Forge.
Player defeats the Forgemaster and the ancient guardians of the Aetherium Forge.
Player uses the Aetherium Forge to craft the Aetherial Crown, Shield, or Staff. Quest completes.
